collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license (AppID 21090). Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.knownRevisions: F.E.A.R. originally released in 2005. The Steam storefront date for this package is May 21, 2010. Related Steam AppIDs exist for associated packages; this accession records AppID 21090 as filed.
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.
